competences.description: Attacks the enemy to transfer 1 harmful effect granted on yourself to the enemy. Increases your Attack Bar by 10% if there are no harmful effects to transfer.

effets.description: Removes a debuff from casting monster and applies it to the target monster.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: If there are no harmful effects to transfer

competences.description: Removes all harmful effects granted on yourself, and then attacks all enemies to decrease their Defense for 2 turns with a 50% chance. Decreases the Defense with a 100% chance if no harmful effects were removed.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.
effets.note: if no harmful effects were removed

competences.description: Gains immunity against inability effects. In addition, transfers all harmful effects granted on all allies to yourself at the start of your turn. Decreases the damage you take by 10% for each harmful effect granted on yourself. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Removes a debuff from casting monster and applies it to the target monster.
effets.note: On all allies to yourself at the start of your turn

effets.description: Decreases damage received by a certain amount
effets.note: For each harmful effect granted on yourself
